# Voice Cloning with Qwen3-TTS

A Google Colab-based voice cloning project powered by **Qwen3-TTS**. This notebook allows users to clone a voice from a reference audio sample and generate high-quality speech from custom text through an automatically generated Gradio interface for a simple and user-friendly experience.

## Features

* Voice cloning using **Qwen3-TTS**
* Runs entirely on Google Colab
* Automatically generated Gradio interface
* Supports WAV and MP3 reference audio uploads
* Generates downloadable WAV audio output
